build_stack_frames_wrapper: build a python module that uses StackFramesWrapper to stack past frames for a Gym environment
build_skip_frames_wrapper: build a python module that uses SkipFramesWrapper to repeat actions over N frames
build_normalize_wrapper: build a python module that uses NormalizeWrapper to normalize low-dimensional observations to a fixed range
build_resize_wrapper: build a python module that uses ResizeWrapper to resize and optionally grayscale observation frames
build_time_limit_wrapper: build a python module that uses TimeLimitWrapper to cap episode length with optional random variation
